definitions.explanation: The condition of not being a citizen of any country. A legal status recognized in international law.

definitions.gloss: having no distinct national character; cosmopolitan; borderless
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe food, music, fashion, or spaces that blend elements from multiple cultures without belonging to any single one.

examples.japanese: {無国籍|むこくせき}の{人々|ひとびと}がいる。
{難民|なんみん}の{中|なか}には{無国籍|むこくせき}になる{人|ひと}もいる。
{無国籍|むこくせき}{者|しゃ}の{権利|けんり}を{守|まも}るための{国際|こくさい}{条約|じょうやく}がある。
examples.english: There are international treaties to protect the rights of stateless persons.

examples.japanese: {無国籍|むこくせき}{料理|りょうり}のレストラン。
このカフェは{無国籍|むこくせき}な{雰囲気|ふんいき}で{落|お}ち{着|つ}く。
examples.english: This café has a cosmopolitan, borderless atmosphere that's relaxing.

examples.japanese: アジアとヨーロッパが{混|ま}ざった{無国籍|むこくせき}なインテリアが{人気|にんき}だ。
examples.english: Interior design blending Asian and European elements in a borderless style is popular.

notes:
{無国籍|むこくせき} uses the prefix {無|む} (without) + {国籍|こくせき} (nationality).

The figurative sense (sense 2) is common in food and lifestyle contexts. {無国籍|むこくせき}{料理|りょうり} refers to fusion cuisine that blends ingredients and techniques from multiple countries without fitting neatly into any single culinary tradition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無国籍|むこくせき}{者|しゃ} — stateless person
- {無国籍|むこくせき}{料理|りょうり} — fusion/borderless cuisine
- {無国籍|むこくせき}な{雰囲気|ふんいき} — cosmopolitan atmosphere
